findings.description: Critical: skills/parallel-infrastructure/scripts/review_dispatcher.py:_config_from_agents_yaml hand-builds principal_id from api_key presence and copies vendor_credentials from raw YAML instead of projecting through openbao_credentials.project_principals(). This diverges from D1/AI-16 (API and direct loader must emit the same canonical shape) and can emit AI-17-illegal keyless rows with non-empty vendor_credentials, accept keyed agents missing explicit vendor_credentials, and skip credential_vendors / openbao_role_id rejection that projection enforces.
findings.resolution: Load topology via project_principals(raw, mount=...) and set principal_id/vendor_credentials from the matching agent principal (or null/[] when absent); fail closed on ProjectionError. Cover with a registry fixture that includes credential_vendors and a negative case for keyless+vendor_credentials.

findings.description: Optional: CFG-25 requires CLI dispatch to retain ambient credentials and never treat a Bao miss as a reason to switch SDK traffic to env keys. The CLI branch correctly skips ApiKeyResolver, but the wp-dispatch suite has no assertion that a CLI-tier dispatch with BAO_ADDR set leaves ApiKeyResolver.resolve uncalled.
findings.resolution: Add a focused test that dispatches a CLI-only reviewer under BAO_ADDR and asserts ApiKeyResolver.resolve is not invoked.

findings.description: FYI: from_config_dict uses sdk["package"] as the resolve() vendor_id for SDK tiers while OpenAI-compatible tiers hard-code openrouter|local. Current agents.yaml aligns package names with credential_vendors, so authz fails closed on mismatch, but the SDK path couples the Python package field to the D1 credential-vendor vocabulary without an explicit mapping.
findings.resolution: Keep as convention if package is guaranteed to equal a credential_vendors entry; otherwise introduce an explicit vendor_id on the SDK wire shape or map package→vendor at config load and reject unknowns.

findings.description: Nit: OpenAI-compatible dispatch fails only when lookup_error is set, then still calls openai_adapter.dispatch with api_key=None when the non-Bao env key is missing. SDK dispatch treats any missing key as AUTH and does not dispatch. Harmless for keyless local (explicit skip), but asymmetric for openrouter/local keyed non-Bao misses.
findings.resolution: For non-keyless OpenAI-compatible reviewers, mirror the SDK gate: if not api_key after resolve, emit AUTH and continue without dispatching.

findings.description: none: ApiKeyResolver.resolve authorizes vendor_id against credential_scopes before constructing OpenBaoClient, and configured Bao failures raise BaoCredentialError without consulting ambient env, BAO_SECRET_ID, or secret/coordinator — matching CFG-01/CFG-04 and D2.
findings.resolution: Retain the authorize-then-read order and the no-fallback Bao path in future edits.

findings.description: none: Both SDK and OpenAI-compatible call sites now resolve via principal_id+vendor_id; keyless local endpoints skip Bao lookup entirely under BAO_ADDR; CLI tier never enters the resolver path; openbao_role_id is removed from adapters and direct/API config shapes.
